# TPC-DS-OBT Q30

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT
    obt.returning_customer_c_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
    obt.bill_addr_ca_state AS ctr_state,
    SUM(obt.return_amount) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.returned_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_d_year = 1999
      AND obt.returning_addr_ca_address_sk = obt.bill_addr_ca_address_sk
    )
    AND channel = 'web'
  GROUP BY
    obt.returning_customer_c_customer_sk,
    obt.bill_addr_ca_state
)
SELECT
  bill_customer_c_customer_id,
  bill_customer_c_salutation,
  bill_customer_c_first_name,
  bill_customer_c_last_name,
  bill_customer_c_preferred_cust_flag,
  bill_customer_c_birth_day,
  bill_customer_c_birth_month,
  bill_customer_c_birth_year,
  bill_customer_c_birth_country,
  bill_customer_c_login,
  bill_customer_c_email_address,
  bill_customer_c_last_review_date_sk,
  ctr_total_return
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
CROSS JOIN customer_total_return AS ctr1
WHERE
  (
    ctr1.ctr_total_return > (
      SELECT
        AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2
      FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2
      WHERE
        ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state
    )
    AND bill_addr_ca_address_sk = bill_customer_c_current_addr_sk
    AND bill_addr_ca_state = '0'
    AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = bill_customer_c_customer_sk
  )
  AND channel = 'web'
ORDER BY
  bill_customer_c_customer_id,
  bill_customer_c_salutation,
  bill_customer_c_first_name,
  bill_customer_c_last_name,
  bill_customer_c_preferred_cust_flag,
  bill_customer_c_birth_day,
  bill_customer_c_birth_month,
  bill_customer_c_birth_year,
  bill_customer_c_birth_country,
  bill_customer_c_login,
  bill_customer_c_email_address,
  bill_customer_c_last_review_date_sk,
  ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
```
